facts.fact: PM-KISAN gives Rs 6,000 a year per land-holding farmer family in three equal instalments
facts.quote: Under the scheme an income support of 6,000/- per year in three equal installments will be provided to all land holding farmer families.

facts.fact: The instalments are paid every four months
facts.quote: financial benefit of Rs.60001 per annum per family payable in three equal installments of Rs.20001 each, every four months.

facts.fact: The 2-hectare limit applied only at launch; the scheme was revised from 1.6.2019 to cover all farmer families irrespective of landholding size
facts.quote: with combined landholding upto 2 hectare. The Scheme was later on revised w.e.f. 1 .6.2019 and extended to all farmer families irrespective of the srze of their
facts.note: Quoted as the page text prints it (OCR-like errors in the PDF text layer, e.g. 'srze' for 'size').

facts.fact: Coverage is subject to the scheme's exclusion criteria
facts.quote: There are various Exclusion Categories for the scheme.

summary: Rs 6,000 a year per family in three equal instalments every four months; the 2-ha limit was dropped from 1.6.2019 (Revised FAQ), subject to exclusions.
